parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualitySignalTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.75 indicates structural near-duplication, the two methods — `recoveryMagnitudeRapidCooling` (line 206) and `recoveryScaleAcceleratesRecovery` (line 223) — are distinct test cases exercising different behavioural aspects of the quality-signal recovery logic (magnitude under rapid cooling vs. scale acceleration). Collapsing them would obscure test intent and reduce failure-site clarity, which is the primary value of separate test methods.
